title: VF-015: Example 109 revisited: Hex#toDigit's regression proof with the Character.digit model
description: Example 109 (apache/commons-codec commit 43a9aa66, Hex.toDigit restricted to ASCII) could not make the regression proof between the old toDigit (Character.digit(ch, 16)) and the new one, because JBMC had no usable Character.digit: a stub, or the JDK's own tables read wrongly. jvmcontract now ships a Character model generated from the JDK's decimal-digit table and runs JBMC without its string solver. This job clones the two commits, compiles src/main/java of each with javac, and runs: (1) prove on the OLD version that toDigit(0x0660, 0) == 0, which the earlier run answered wrongly as violated; (2) equivalence between the versions, expected to find the intended change (a Unicode digit the old version decodes and the new one rejects); (3) equivalence with --unchanged-unless 'ch > 127', expected verified: on ASCII nothing changed. A violation in (3) would be a real finding about the commit. Resubmitted with its steps unchanged by the cleanup loop's native stream (VF-015): JDK models have shipped with jvmcontract since the first run, whose step 3 could not replay JBMC's witness because the interpreter refused to read java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets.UTF_8. Closes VF-015 when it passes.
expected: step 3 verified in seconds; step 4 a violation whose witness is a non-ASCII digit, replayed in the interpreter (before: a digit value, after: DecoderException); step 5 verified over every char x int

resources.notes: 109's property proofs took under a second each; a clone with --filter=blob:none and two worktrees is the slow part

steps.name: clone
steps.run: mkdir -p verification/.work-109 && cd verification/.work-109 && git clone --filter=blob:none https://github.com/apache/commons-codec codec && git -C codec worktree add ../base 87f6aa28 && git -C codec worktree add ../head 43a9aa663c1b10b32a7cc6bbc1eccc10bba5f9be

steps.name: compile
steps.run: mkdir -p base-classes head-classes && javac -proc:none -parameters -g -nowarn -d base-classes $(find base/src/main/java -name '*.java') && javac -proc:none -parameters -g -nowarn -d head-classes $(find head/src/main/java -name '*.java')

steps.name: old toDigit decodes the Arabic-Indic zero
the change, found
steps.run: jvmcontract equivalence --before base-classes --after head-classes --target 'org.apache.commons.codec.binary.Hex#toDigit' --timeout 600 --work work-change; test $? -eq 1
